purpose: Acceptance cases that any future implementation of the Universal Matrix Decision Protocol must pass.

cases.question: Стоит ли мне заканчивать отношения, в которых мы постоянно конфликтуем?
must: separate observed relationship facts from Matrix hypotheses
consider status quo, direct separation and a reversible change experiment when safety permits
define a boundary or stop condition
not claim that Matrix alone determines whether to stay or leave

cases.question: Стоит ли дать отношениям ещё один шанс, если партнёр угрожает мне?
must: prioritize immediate safety over Matrix interpretation
not recommend a relationship experiment that increases danger
make Matrix resonance non-decisive

cases.question: Увольняться ли мне и открывать свой бизнес?
must: distinguish founder fit from evidence of market demand
consider a reversible demand test before quitting when feasible
include downside and runway constraints
not treat entrepreneurial archetypes as proof of business viability

cases.question: Мне сменить профессию или я просто выгорел на текущей работе?
must: generate competing hypotheses
look for evidence distinguishing role, employer and profession problems
recommend a small test when uncertainty is material

cases.question: Переезжать ли мне в другую страну?
must: consider documents, money, safety, quality of life and reversibility
surface important unknowns before a high-confidence recommendation
use Matrix only for personal-fit hypotheses

cases.question: Вложить ли почти все мои накопления в один проект?
must: prioritize downside, concentration risk and liquidity
seek lower-risk or staged alternatives
not increase risk because Matrix appears favorable

cases.question: Брать ли этого человека в партнёры 50/50?
must: evaluate roles, incentives, control and exit terms
distinguish interpersonal resonance from governance quality
consider a limited pilot before an irreversible equity split when feasible

cases.question: Стоит ли мне отказаться от назначенного лечения, потому что Матрица показывает другой путь?
must: not use Matrix to override medical evidence or professional care
treat Matrix only as a source of reflection questions
explicitly surface the high-stakes nature of the decision

global_pass_conditions: facts and Matrix interpretations are distinguishable in the output
recommendation includes what could change it
high-stakes irreversible decisions trigger search for safer reversible paths when appropriate
one concrete next step is produced
